bugs_found_and_fixed.title: Rating panel visible on every page load
bugs_found_and_fixed.cause: .killi-rate-panel set display:flex unconditionally, beating the browser's [hidden] rule.
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Added .killi-rate-panel[hidden] { display: none; } guard. (Superseded by 5aefcab — rating moved inline into the chat feed, no [hidden]-toggled panel at all anymore.)

bugs_found_and_fixed.title: Mobile swipe-to-reveal record cards didn't actually swipe
bugs_found_and_fixed.cause: .admin-swipe-actions used inset:0, stretching it to the full card width, so the JS-measured reveal distance was ~4x too large.
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Changed to top/bottom/right only (no left), so it sizes to its own button content.

bugs_found_and_fixed.title: Result-detail modal resized on every tab switch
bugs_found_and_fixed.cause: .killi-modal was one scroll container around header+tabs+all tab-sections, so its box height matched whichever tab was visible.
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Fixed-height flex column; only a new .killi-modal-body wrapper scrolls, header/tabs stay pinned.

bugs_found_and_fixed.title: Modal action row silently dropped WhatsApp
bugs_found_and_fixed.cause: buildActionRow() (modal) and the card's own action-row builder were two separate hardcoded entry lists that drifted apart — card offered Call/Directions/Website/WhatsApp, modal offered Call/Directions/Website/Share for the same record.
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Modal now uses the identical four entries in the identical order as the card; removed the now-dead shareRecord() helper.

bugs_found_and_fixed.title: Intent detection misrouted any message containing "this" (or similar) to the greeting intent
bugs_found_and_fixed.cause: ConversationEngine::detectIntent() used plain str_contains() with no word boundaries, so the greeting pattern "hi" matched *inside* the word "this" — e.g. "mechanic near this address" silently became a greeting reply instead of a search.
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Pad the normalized message and each pattern with spaces and match ' pattern ' — same phrase-boundary technique TaxonomyEngine/LocationEngine already use.

bugs_found_and_fixed.title: Capitalized queries lost all context detection
bugs_found_and_fixed.cause: TaxonomyEngine::extractTaxonomy() and LocationEngine::extractLocation() both ran preg_replace('/[^a-z0-9\\s]/u', ...) BEFORE mb_strtolower() — since the character class only allowed lowercase a-z, every capital letter was silently stripped first. "Cars" (capitalized) detected nothing; "cars" (lowercase) worked.
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Switched both to a \\p{L}\\p{N} Unicode class, which matches letters regardless of case, so the operation order no longer matters.

bugs_found_and_fixed.title: Server-side mime sniffing made every voice note render as a silent video player
bugs_found_and_fixed.cause: finfo sniffs an audio-only WebM recording (from MediaRecorder) as video/webm, not audio/webm — the container format is genuinely ambiguous without deeper inspection.
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: uploadAttachment() now accepts an optional 'voice' kind hint the client sets explicitly for recordings started via the Voice Note button, overriding the render hint after upload rather than trusting the sniffed mime for that one case.

deferred_or_rejected.note: Full handoff spec written in KILLI_BUILD_STATUS.md; scoped rephrase-only, Ultra-gated, never free generation.

Reversed from the earlier 'rejected_for_now' call. Built as a small offline lexicon scorer (core/SentimentEngine.php + config/sentiment.json) with Levenshtein/Soundex typo tolerance — no ML model, no external API, ~50 words per polarity. Softens the reply and surfaces Raise-a-request/Try-again quick replies on a negative read. See KILLI_BUILD_STATUS.md for the full writeup and the two detection bugs it surfaced.

Considered when the small lexicon missed a typo'd word. The actual gap was typo tolerance and one missing word ("working"), not list size — a 2,500+ word generic list would raise false-positive risk on domain-neutral words more than it improves real coverage for a business-search chat. Lexicon grown modestly (~35→~48 words) instead.

deferred_or_rejected.idea: Explicit "did you mean 'not'?" clarifying question for likely typos
deferred_or_rejected.note: Considered for sentiment word typos specifically. Chose silent fuzzy-match tolerance instead (SentimentEngine::classify()) — a bot second-guessing every typo reads as more robotic, not less; the real ask underneath ("tell me what to do next") is served better by the Raise-a-request/Try-again quick replies that were built instead.
